job.title: Senior Software Engineer (Backend focused)
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

A marketplace at your scale lives on fast, reliable backend services – I have built Java/Spring APIs and integrations for global e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell for 5+ years.

– Query refactoring that reduced response latency
– REST APIs and data pipelines across global channels
– Code reviews and mentoring in international teams

I work independently and results-driven in international, agile teams – remote, hybrid or on-site. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. My CV and cover letter are attached. I would be glad to show you in a short call what I can deliver for GetYourGuide.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Senior Software Engineer (Backend) | Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs & Microservices
tailoring.summary: Senior backend engineer with 5+ years building and running large enterprise e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices and data integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency; experienced in SQL performance tuning, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, Git and production troubleshooting. Performs code reviews and mentors junior developers in agile, international teams. Uses AI-assisted development daily. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: GetYourGuide connects travellers with experiences worldwide, and its product depends on a strong backend for inventory, booking and partner integrations. These are problems I know from large e-commerce platforms. I want to bring my Java, API and performance experience to an English-speaking, product-driven engineering team in Berlin.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, your Senior Backend Engineer role caught my eye: 5+ years of Java/Spring, REST APIs and integrations for global e-commerce at Rockwell Automation and Shell, incl. latency-cutting query refactoring. Start 16.12.2026. Happy to chat!

en.subject: Application: Senior Software Engineer (Backend focused)
en.hook: A marketplace at GetYourGuide's scale lives on fast, reliable backend services. I have built exactly that kind of backend for more than five years: Java and Spring services, REST APIs and data integrations for global e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, including query refactoring that cut response latency.

bullets.label: Backend services & APIs
bullets.text: Built RESTful APIs and web services in Java and Spring for headless commerce, PWA frontends and third-party consumers, following design patterns and best practices.

bullets.label: Performance
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed; optimized SQL queries and data pipelines.

bullets.label: Data integrations at scale
bullets.text: Designed and optimized data pipelines that keep product catalogs synchronized across global channels; engineered API migrations that improved stability and data consistency.

bullets.label: Engineering culture
bullets.text: Code reviews, production support and mentoring of junior developers; CI/CD deployment cycles in agile, international teams.

en.logistics: I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit and can start at GetYourGuide on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would welcome a conversation to show you the concrete contribution I can make to your team.
